name: Algarve , Porto Mos
description:
Sydvendt bratt kystheng ca 2 km. langt.
Stor parkering ute i østenden 10 m. over strandnivå.
Kanten stiger slakt oppover med flere startmuligheter på vei opp til toppstarten.
Hele veien fra parkeringen opp til toppstarten er det flotte landingsmuligheter på stranden under.
Fra hovedstarten og vestover er det et ca. 100 m. høyt heng, men da uten mulighet for landing under.

name: Azorerna - Pico sa Barrosa, Lagoa do Fogo
description:
Thermal flights. Very suitable for 
cross-country. Various take-offs are suitable, in differ-
ent directions. Two geothermal power plants located 
in proximity to the site allow the formation of strong 
(artificial) thermals, which can be used by experienced 
pilots to optimize their flights. 

CAUTION Do not fly without giving previous 
notice to local pilots and without permission from the 
competent authorities. Avoid overflying the thermal 
plants when approaching the official landing area.

name: Azores - Mata dos Valados
description: Easy to get to by car for take off. Nice take off and landing on the meadows by the sea.

name: Azores - Salto de Cavalo, Furnas
description:
An amazing site over the beautiful Furnas valley. Flights are mostly thermal, during several hours. The site is very suitable for cross-country. Large and easy take-off areas.

CAUTION: Do not fly without giving previous notice to local pilots and without permission from the competent authorities.

name: Azores - Santa Barbara beach
description: Soaring place. Start above the beach or start directly on the beach if there is a little more wind. Large parking nearby and good restaurant on the beach.

name: Azores - Sete Citades
description:
One of the most beautiful sites in the world to fly, within a breath-taking landscape. The range offers 3 different launch areas, depending on wind direction and intensity. Site with easy landing options. Flights can be mostly thermal.

CAUTION Do not fly without giving previous notice to local pilots and without permission from the competent authorities.

name: Caldelas (Braga)
description:
It is a low place good for thermodynamic flight. 

Caldelas is about 15 km north of Braga, in Minho region's heart. It is a place with good take-offs and relatively close to those living in Braga, Porto and surrounding area. 

To get there, take the road to Vila Verde (EN 101), after Cávado river turn to Amares (EN 205), then left to Terras de Bouro(EN205-3). Reached Caldelas follow the road to Braga (EN 308) and turn left to Paranhos just after Hotel Termas de Caldelas, and climb up the TV antennas. 

Takeoff is large, easy and clean. 

Landings consists of large fields, requiring attention to farmland. 

It is quite popular, especially for those living in Braga and for Abouaaboua paragliding club pilots.

(check it also here: http://locais-voo.ko-ok.com.pt/sites/view/51)

name: Lisboa, Praia da Santa Rita
description:
Current description (per 2025):

Flight type: coastal soaring
Ideal wind direction: NW
Difficulty: easy (technical on strong winds)

Altitude: 32m (97ft)
GPS coordinates: 39.164212, -9.362255
Radio frequencies: 143.950 MHz / 143.9375 MHz / 143.925 MHz (simplex-only)

Rules and cautions for pilots:
- If you are a newcomer, please talk with local pilots before take off
- Don’t fly alone
- Carefully check the flying conditions
- Free the area if you aren’t about to launch
- Respect in-flight priorities
- During summer, respect the beachgoers space if you need to land on the brach
- Respect the site. Keep it clean all the time

Rules for visitors:
- Avoid the takeoff/landing area and follow pilots’ instructions

Fly safe and have fun!

name: Madeira, Arco da Calheta
description: Half hour drive west of Funchal. Insert Madeira Paragliding in Google Maps. Relaxed «hippie» mood. Hartmut is site owner. €5 daily fee (2022). Get weather and flying tips from friendly tandem pilots. Ask about top landing technique before you start, or better yet: Watch them do it. Better than landing on rocky beach by the cemetary just east of Madalena do Mar. Check meteo wind on mountain behind by looking at windmills. Clockwise  rotation when viewed from takeoff: Southerly. Anti-clockwise: Northerly backwind. Very nice site with ridgesoaring in front and to the west combined with good thermals once it heats up

name: Madeira, Cabo Girao
description:
Kjør til utsiktspunktet, Cabo Girao, 12 km vest for Funchal. Når du står på utsiktspunktet er starten 200 meter vest. Følg hovedveien 300 meter vestover, takeoff er 15 meter fra veien. 

Lang og noe bratt skråning med opparbeidet gress på hele starten. Ligger på verdens nest høyeste fjellklippe og ruver 580 moh.

Det er noen trær foran på starten, men på grunn av hellingen på start og man står på en 500 meter bratt fjellklippe, kan man ta av her på relativt svak vind inn.

Hovedlanding er på Praia Formosa, ca 10 km unna. Det er fint mulig å gli helt bort til landing på svake vinder.

Det er også mulig å lande på strendene før, både den rett under start, ved Teleferico Rancho og på stranda ved Paria de Vigario.

Takeoff is about 300 meters to west, just follow the western road from Cabo Girão. Nice grassy and steep takeoff. Even though there are some trees at the bottom of the bottom, it is possible to take off in light winds due to the lift from the steep wall belove.

Main landing is Praia Formosa, about 10 km away, and its possible to fly all the way even on lighter winds.

It's also possible to land on the beach right beneath Cabo Girao and the beach Praia de Vigario.
